name: chart-bar-01
title: chart-bar-01
description: Completed orders · first half of 2026. June was the strongest month of the half.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Orders on the rise” with the muted eyebrow “Completed orders · first half of 2026”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Plot Jan–Jun order counts 186, 225, 208, 284, 312, 368 as single-color vertical bars with rounded top corners and a maximum width of 40px. Show 1,583 orders and a footer identifying June as the strongest month.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips. Use Jan–Jun month labels, a numeric vertical axis, subtle horizontal grid lines, and muted axis labels and baselines.

Build the chart with TanStack Charts. Use responsive chart geometry, theme-aware chart colors, a labeled legend, and pointer and keyboard value tooltips.
